description: Defines the AppLocalizations class that manages localized strings for the application, supporting English and Sinhala languages. Provides methods to access localized content based on the current locale and includes localization delegates.

classes.name: AppLocalizations
classes.description: Provides localized strings for the app, supporting multiple languages and exposing static methods to retrieve localized content based on context.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Retrieves the current instance of AppLocalizations from the BuildContext.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Fetches the localized string for a given key based on the current locale.
